opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Regular Grant under £100,000. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget. Capital and project grants tend to be approximately 10-20% of costs; local community projects (e.g. village halls, community centres, places of worship) are likely to be no greater than £30,000 regardless of project size.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities. Only one application at a time; must wait a year after a previous application outcome.
opportunities.summary: Grants for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Operating/core cost grants support general running costs (one year or multi-year over 2-3 years); capital grants for building works/repairs or necessary equipment; project grants for specific projects with defined scope and timescale. Supports charities working in Arts, Community, Education, Environment, Faith, Health, Museums and Heritage, Welfare and Youth.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)

amount.raw: Grants of £100,000 and over. To be considered, organisation must either have annual income over £1 million, or total project/capital costs must be over £1 million.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million regardless of annual income. For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and over for capital/project costs or core costs, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest form all year round with no deadlines; Expressions of Interest are reviewed on a rolling basis, and if taken forward the applicant is invited to submit a full proposal for consideration at a board meeting.
